verdict.rationale: Steel is browser infrastructure for AI agents. A product like this could plausibly offer in-product AI insights, such as AI summaries of session or trace data, so the axis applies. No evidence shows Steel itself generates insights or suggestions from user data. Agent Traces only presents a timeline and exports of agent activity, and the debugging skill is an external agent skill, so both are adjacent features rather than in-product AI insights.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
